unit.why: A single anecdote about R. Fishel of Strykov as a young man, living at his father-in-law's table, who naively plans to support his family by selling bagels.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מהסבא קדישא ר׳ פישעל זצ"ל
stories.end_quote: מזה נראה איך תמימות שלו היה
stories.summary_en: As a young man supported by his rich father-in-law, R. Fishel of Strykov is so absorbed in spiritual ascent that he forgets his wife's request to find a livelihood; when he finally tries, he happily proposes that she sell bagels like a woman in the market, which shows his simplicity.

quotes: ואמרה לו אשתו איך שאבי׳ אינו רוצה
אמרה לו אשתו מה יהא התכלית שלנו
ואמר לאשתו איך שמצא סיבה לפרנסה
